title: Cancellation, Drop and Closure of a Commercial Natural Gas Supply Agreement
content:
**Cancellation.** The business cancels an active Commercial Natural Gas Supply agreement by confirming the cancellation. The drop takes effect on the site's next scheduled meter read date, recorded as the drop effective date, and the agreement is drop pending until then.

**No withdrawal of a confirmed cancellation.** A confirmed commercial gas cancellation cannot be withdrawn. A business that changes its mind re-enrolls the site after the drop at the then-valid price offer.

**Closure reasons.**

| How supply ended | Close reason recorded |
|---|---|
| The utility completes the drop after a confirmed cancellation | Cancelled by customer |
| Another supplier enrolls the site | Switched to other supplier |
| The site is final-billed | Final billed |

The second and third closures end Beacon Ridge supply directly from active status.

## Illustration (hypothetical)

A florist confirms cancellation of its Beacon Ridge Commercial Gas agreement on 2025-06-03; the site's next scheduled meter read is 2025-06-20, so the drop effective date is 2025-06-20. On 2025-06-10 the florist asks to keep the agreement. The confirmed cancellation cannot be withdrawn; the florist may re-enroll the site after the drop, at the price offer valid at that time.
